scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @demo/api && npm run build -w @demo/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @demo/api" "npm run dev -w @demo/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @demo/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @demo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @demo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @demo/api && npm run typecheck -w @demo/web
